_comment: The real community mailboxes, supplied by Austin 2026-09-09 from the M365
group list. STORED, NOT DERIVED -- and that is the finding: the addresses
follow no rule the roster can reproduce. `obo@` and `pse@` are initialisms,
`triples@` drops a word, `vantageoak@` is singular where the roster is plural,
`GreenPointe@` spells what the roster calls Greene Pointe, and one mailbox
serves both Bay Oaks villages. Any generator would get several of these wrong
and mail would go to the wrong park, so the mapping is data and is reviewed by
Keyed by roster short code. Case is preserved as supplied though SMTP does not
care. pipeline/routing.py consumes this and reports anything unmatched in
either direction rather than silently dropping it.

_why: Bay Oaks Village II has no mailbox of its own and shares Village I's.
Northgate RV has none and shares Northgate MH's.
Recorded rather than left as a gap, because an alert for these parks has
somewhere real to go -- but the mail lands in a shared inbox, so anything
sent must name the community in the subject or the recipient cannot tell

_not_a_community.regionalmgmt: Functional mailbox, not a park. Candidate escalation target for anything that has no community address or has gone unanswered, but never a per-community route.

_unresolved.Spacecoastvillage: No community of this name in the reportable roster. Either a park we do not report on, a renamed one, or a mailbox that outlived its community. Nobody has said which.
_unresolved.geigerkey: Geiger Key RV Resort, removed from the roster at Austin's direction. Mailbox exists; nothing routes to it.
_unresolved.shellpointe: Shell Pointe MHC, sold July 2026. Mailbox still exists. Must never be routed to.
